name: smwgraphics-modernized-mario
title: Modernized Mario
description:
These are graphics for our favorite plumber, without losing the essence of Super Mario World.

These graphics were made by Kusamochi, please give it credit.

This was presented on my C3 2021 Thread.

This graphics work with the vanilla palette, but i included a custom shared palette that have the modern colors.

This requires the 32x32 player tilemap .
